DEFECTS_FOUND.defect: Found during the RTL/LTR recapture: the Labs graph model passed the LOCALIZED relationship label as `edge.type`, and the shared relation classifier resolves stroke class from English tokens only (/(optional|conditional|branch)/ → related, /depend|linear|canonical|…/ → canonical). In AR every edge therefore fell through to `related` and rendered dashed/blue — including the three Linear Dependency edges — while the AR legend's first swatch is solid and the EN session renders those edges solid/green. Stroke presentation thus depended on the active language (direction-visible inconsistency).
DEFECTS_FOUND.fix: surface-local, no shared file edited: board.ts graphModel now states the shared `styleClass` token explicitly (`canonical` for linear kinds, `related` for conditional/optional kinds) while `type` keeps carrying the localized visible label and accessible name. The shared presentation honours an explicit styleClass first, so rendering becomes direction-independent and the legend swatch matches the stroke in both locales.
